title: Alaska Picks Its Youngest Governor Ever
summary:
Alaska has a new governor, and he is the youngest in the state's history. Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, won the race, according to a call by the Associated Press. He will replace outgoing Governor Mike Dunleavy, a Republican who has led the state since 2018. Alaska's last Democratic governor left office in 2002.

Kreiss-Tomkins is a former state representative from Sitka, a small island community, known by his initials, JKT. He built his campaign around what he called a "high-energy, bipartisan, problem-solving approach," and says he plans an administration of Democrats, Republicans, and independents. At a debate he called himself a "man of the middle."

His message won support from unusual places: three former governors, a Democrat, a Republican, and an independent, plus Republican Senator Lisa Murkowski. "I strongly believe people just want things to work, and want people to work together," Kreiss-Tomkins said in an interview on Election Day.

The result took more than a week to call, as workers counted votes sent by mail and from far-flung parts of the state. Alaska uses a ranked-choice system, in which voters rank candidates in order. Kreiss-Tomkins faced three Republican candidates, including one backed by President Trump. To win, a candidate needs a majority.

Voters also decided a ballot question about whether to scrap the ranked-choice system. That proposal failed, so the system stays in place.

Kreiss-Tomkins takes office at noon on December 7. He will lead a state where many voters say things are not working as they should. Rising costs and flat state funding have forced schools to close and class sizes to grow, food, fuel, and housing have all become more expensive, and many Alaskans have been moving away for more than a decade.
why_it_matters: Governors make decisions that affect schools, roads, and daily life in their state. Alaska's new governor won by promising to work with all parties, and how he does will matter to everyone who lives there.
